items.title: Modern Luxury: How Creativity Translates Ideas into Value
items.raw_summary: In the contemporary luxury landscape, value is no longer defined by heritage alone. What increasingly differentiates premium brands is their ability to generate ideas—and, more importantly, to translate them into measurable business outcomes.
